apps.name: TallyDex
apps.subtitle: Track Pokémon TCG sets and your collection.
apps.localizedDescription: A native, local-first iPhone app for browsing Pokémon TCG series and sets and building a personal collection.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds exact Cardmarket 1-day, 7-day, and 30-day rolling averages supplied by TCGdex, including holo-specific values. Averages appear per printing in card details and Price History, remain separate from locally accumulated daily history, persist offline, and require no extra API call.

Adds explicit offline set downloads with complete card metadata, printing variants, grid images, and full-size artwork. Long-press a released set or use its toolbar to see a storage estimate and download progress; pinned files live outside automatic cache cleanup and can be managed per set in Settings.

When price-history retention is set to Forever, its automatic storage ceiling is now configurable as 50 MB, 100 MB, 250 MB, 500 MB, or 1 GB. The default is 50 MB, lowering the limit prunes the oldest snapshots immediately, and date-based modes retain their existing time and safety limits.

Adds Price Data storage reporting, one-year history retention by default, a permanent 250,000-point history ceiling, history-only and full market-data purge controls, and a 400 MB least-recently-used artwork ceiling. Card details now reuse their 18-hour cache, pull-to-refresh avoids forcing every price, unchanged complete search indexes use zero-body TCGdex ETag responses, and charts show their saved-day coverage.

Fixes the Price History area fill extending below the chart and appearing behind the summary cards, explanatory text, and bottom tab bar. The fill now uses the visible price range as its baseline and is clipped to the chart bounds.

Adds exact per-printing price-history charts to card details with 7-day, 30-day, 90-day, and all-time ranges. Cardmarket EUR and TCGplayer USD histories remain separate, with current, change, low, and high statistics and honest one-point or empty states while daily history accumulates.

Fixes the physical-device import handoff where tapping a visible backup closed or stalled the picker without opening Import Preview. TallyDex now imports a local copy and coordinates both possible picker-dismiss and selection-callback orders before presenting the validated backup.

Fixes older backups that Files classifies with a legacy, dynamic, or provider-specific document type. Import Backup now permits selection first, validates the JSON inside TallyDex, opens valid backups in Import Preview, and displays an immediate error for invalid files.

Fixes .pokecollection backup imports by registering the TallyDex backup document type with iOS. Exported backups are now selectable in the file importer and can be tapped directly in Files to open the same safe Import Preview.

Adds versioned .pokecollection JSON backups, human-readable CSV export, Files integration, detailed import previews, idempotent timestamp-aware Merge, guarded Replace, and an automatic local rollback snapshot before imports.

Adds a Missing or Incorrect Card option to Settings, explains that TallyDex uses TCGdex as its single catalog source, links to new and existing TallyDex GitHub card-data reports, and provides a structured issue form for verifiable corrections.

Adds an exact Open on Cardmarket action to card details and repairs missing Normal, Reverse Holo, and Holo choices by combining TCGdex variant flags with its detailed marketplace printing data, including already-cached cards.

Fixes exact per-printing marketplace prices and card-detail tab-bar clearance, adds partial ownership progress rings, advanced Search filters and layouts, configurable default Custom collection rules, and a saved Cardmarket listing-country preference.

Adds exact per-printing Cardmarket EUR and TCGplayer USD prices supplied by TCGdex, configurable price-source settings, quantity-aware values for sets, custom folders, and the full collection, explicit unpriced-printing counts, an 18-hour price cache, and daily local price snapshots.

Loads and caches all TCGdex printing variants independently of each set goal, hides extra printings in Normal while revealing them instantly in Master, preserves richer cached variant data, adds a default collection-goal setting, and creates restorable backups before goal changes.

Adds pull-down search inside sets, simplifies collection goals to Normal, Master, and Custom, defaults ownership to a single checkmark with optional exact quantities, and adds Lucario Prerelease and Prerelease Staff printings.

Makes My Sets and Hidden functional, adds All/Owned/Missing set filters, Complete/Holo Chase/Custom goals with goal-aware progress, collection-folder search/filter/sort, and per-card wishlist and notes.

Adds persistent custom collection folders powered by card-name rules, All or Owned display modes, cross-set completion progress, source-set labels, quick ownership checkmarks, and long-press folder editing.

Adds persistent per-printing card quantities, quick checkmarks in set grids, Main and Master collection goals configured by long-pressing a set and choosing Edit, live cards-owned progress, and a populated Collection tab.
Preloads and caches the complete searchable card index, identifies each result by set and collector number, and supports combined searches such as Hidden Fates Metapod without opening the set first.

Automatically checks for catalog updates, adds cached card grids and detailed card views, enables local card search, fixes missing-artwork fallbacks, and protects original TallyDex work with a proprietary license.

Caches all catalog artwork for faster cold launches, adds selective cache controls and copyright attribution, uses the TallyDex mark for missing artwork, and enlarges series logos on the main Sets page.
Shows authentic expansion symbols for pre-Scarlet & Violet sets, includes announced upcoming sets, improves special-collection artwork fallbacks, and adds IPA distribution.
